label: Leuven 离子束设备 product line
definition: Issuer product line 离子束设备 across FY2023-FY2025. The issuer defines it as ion-beam-shaping centred, and it contains BOTH material-removal ion-beam tools (12-inch Pangea ion-beam shaping, the LMEC-300 emerging-memory platform, 8-inch Lorem) AND the 8-inch Ganister ion-beam DEPOSITION (IBD) family. It therefore spans ion_beam_etch_milling and deposition_ion_beam and must not be read as an ion-beam-etch-only figure. Sales and production are counted in process chambers (腔), which the issuer states are the separately priced functional units, not whole systems.

label: Leuven ICP 刻蚀设备 product line
definition: Issuer product line ICP 刻蚀设备 across FY2023-FY2025: 12-inch Chimera and 8-inch Pishow inductively-coupled-plasma etchers. The issuer states that every plasma etcher it sold in the reporting period was ICP, not CCP. Counted in process chambers (腔), not systems.

label: Leuven 其他设备 product line
definition: Issuer residual product line 其他设备 = CVD equipment plus VPD equipment. A mixed basket; the issuer reports its CVD and VPD volumes separately but not its revenue separately.

label: Leuven CVD 设备 product line
definition: Issuer CVD equipment (8-inch Shale series, 1-3 PECVD chambers) for SiC/GaN third-generation semiconductor and optoelectronic device films. Volume is counted in process chambers (腔).

label: Leuven VPD 设备 product line
definition: Issuer VPD equipment (Seehund series, one chamber) for 8-inch and 12-inch IC manufacturing, 12-inch large-silicon-wafer production and reclaimed wafers. The ONLY Leuven line counted in whole systems (台); the issuer states VPD is sold per system while all other lines are sold and counted per process chamber.

label: Leuven 主营业务 total
definition: Issuer main-business total across all equipment lines. Smaller than total operating revenue, which also contains 其他业务收入.

label: Leuven consolidated company
definition: Company-wide consolidated figures from the prospectus summary financial table.

label: Leuven 直接销售 main business
definition: Issuer sales-mode row 直接销售: direct sales to industrial wafer-fab and display customers.

label: Leuven 贸易商销售 main business
definition: Issuer sales-mode row 贸易商销售: buy-out trader sales, mainly to universities and research institutes and their designated traders.

label: Leuven 境内 main business
definition: Issuer geography row 境内 (domestic).

label: Leuven 境外 main business
definition: Issuer geography row 境外 (overseas). Non-zero only in FY2024.

label: Leuven 核心技术产品 revenue
definition: Issuer-defined core-technology product revenue, which for this issuer equals main-business revenue in every reporting year.

label: Leuven Pangea 12-inch ion-beam shaping equipment
definition: Named 12 英寸离子束塑形设备 (Pangea series) for advanced-logic and memory wafer pattern shaping and wafer-surface ultra-planarisation. Issuer states industrialised application status, sold to 客户 B and 中科院, under validation at 客户 H and 客户 F.

label: Leuven LMEC-300 12-inch special metal-film etch platform
definition: Named 12 英寸特种金属膜层刻蚀设备 (LMEC-300) for MRAM and other emerging-memory patterning. A combined platform whose chamber complement mixes ion-beam shaping, ICP etch and PECVD on one vacuum transfer platform; classified here by its ion-beam milling core function.

label: Leuven Lorem 8-inch ion-beam equipment
definition: Named 8 英寸离子束设备 (Lorem series) for MEMS noble-metal layers, AR/VR micro-display gratings, optoelectronic and power-device shaping.

label: Leuven Ganister 8-inch IBD equipment
definition: Named 8 英寸 IBD 设备 (Ganister series) for hard-disk heads, hard-magnetic bias layers and Bragg reflectors. Ion-beam deposition, not ion-beam etch.

label: Leuven Chimera 12-inch ICP etch equipment
definition: Named 12 英寸 ICP 刻蚀设备 (Chimera series) for silicon, metal-film and hard-mask etch in advanced logic and memory.

label: Leuven Pishow 8-inch ICP etch equipment
definition: Named 8 英寸 ICP 刻蚀设备 (Pishow series) for silicon-based power devices and SiC/GaN third-generation semiconductor etch.

label: Leuven Shale 8-inch CVD equipment
definition: Named 8 英寸 CVD 设备 (Shale series) with PECVD chambers for SiC/GaN and optoelectronic devices.

label: Leuven Seehund VPD equipment
definition: Named VPD 设备 (Seehund series), single chamber, for metal-contamination detection on 8-inch and 12-inch IC lines, 12-inch large silicon wafers and reclaimed wafers.

label: Leuven generic single ion-beam tool chamber configuration
definition: Issuer statement of how many process chambers a single ion-beam tool can currently carry, given as a platform capability in the core-technology section. A product-design capability, not chambers shipped or installed.

label: Leuven generic single ICP etch tool chamber configuration
definition: Issuer statement of how many process chambers a single ICP etch tool can currently carry. A product-design capability, not chambers shipped or installed.

label: Leuven total domestic and overseas patents
definition: Issuer count of held domestic and overseas patents as of the reporting period end.

label: Leuven invention patents
definition: Issuer count of held invention patents; also cited as the STAR-Market industrialisable invention-patent criterion as of 2025-12-31.

label: Leuven R&D personnel
definition: Issuer R&D headcount and its share of total employees as of 2025-12-31.
